core_obligations: Set up the identities valid for an arbitrary Riemannian metric and linearise them around the Einstein--Hermitian metric (proof lines 347-352).
Introduce the constant conformal factor Omega with weights w=1, p=0 and grad_a Omega = 0 and define the auxiliary quantities (proof lines 352-360).
Compute both sides of the claimed identity term by term and match them (proof lines 360-377).
proof_roadmap: The conformal factor and the auxiliary tensors (proof lines 352-360).
Term-by-term verification of the identity (proof lines 360-377).
difficulty_reason: H2：312-376从任意Riemannian度规的Weyl/Bianchi spinor恒等式，构造含Lee form的conformal/GHP联络算子；识别quadratic coupling项，在Einstein-Hermitian背景线性化时消失，得到linearized Einstein与Teukolsky标量算子的decoupling identity。难点是加权spinor结构与linearization相容，非单独坐标展开；保留160-376全上下文与作者引用。
